title: Treaty of Pereyaslav
summary: On 18 January 1654 a Cossack council at Pereyaslav submitted Ukraine to the Russian tsar Alexis, and his emissaries accepted. Ukraine became a protectorate of the tsar. The agreement set off a Russo-Polish war (1654–67), and historians still dispute how the lost terms should be read.

importance.justification: Linked Cossack Ukraine to Muscovy and triggered the Russo-Polish war, with long-term effects on Ukrainian history.
